# Atomic persistence of compilation state and delta

This function implements the atomic persist stage of the compilation pipeline. It applies all changes (entity upserts, deletions, relationship diffs, provenance snapshots, and delta log appends) within a single transaction. If any part fails, no partial changes are committed, ensuring a consistent compiled state even in the event of a crash.
